description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the EmpEmergencyContact entity in the OrangeHRM system. It sets up test data, persists an employee and their emergency contact, and verifies the entity's properties and database retrieval correctness.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the EmpEmergencyContact entity, testing creation, persistence, and retrieval of emergency contact data for an employee.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test environment by truncating relevant database tables before each test.

methods.name: testEmpEmergencyContactEntity
methods.description: Creates an Employee and EmpEmergencyContact, persists them, retrieves, and asserts the correctness of stored data.
